Date: 25 June 2025. Chair: Hoàng Thu Hà, Chairwoman of the Board of Directors. Attendees: Vũ Đức Khánh, Chief Executive Officer.

## Resolutions

The Board approved the launch of the Beta Mobile app for retail customers.
